description: Use this to find games for a group when you don't have a specific game in mind ("3 friends, one on PS5 and one on Xbox"). Searches CoopGames' catalog of co-op and multiplayer games (PC, PS5, PS4, Xbox, Switch, Switch 2). All filters are optional and combine with AND. With several platforms it returns only games with crossplay between all of them. Returns up to 10 games, most popular first, with the total that match; each has its CoopGames page url, platforms, online and same-screen player counts, crossplay and price. For one known game use get_game instead. Read-only.
